criteria.description: PUT /packs/{packId} with a tar.gz or zip archive of the authored pack directory is accepted 202 with a status URI and ends succeeded (created or replaced), after which the service holds exactly the archive's artifacts, edges and presets, an artifact the new archive omits answering 404.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A pack that does not exist yet is created, and everything the archive carries is readable"; contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A replace drops what the new archive leaves out and keeps what it carries"
criteria.notes: Delivered in PR A (#419, WP14/WP16); asynchronous by DM-01M6RA8225EXG6GAT1MM2R9T6C (A5).

criteria.description: Any new pack_version replaces the stored one, an identical re-send ends succeeded with outcome unchanged and the same revision, and the same version with different content ends refused 409 pack_version_conflict leaving the stored pack unchanged.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "The same version with other content is refused, and a new version is accepted"; contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "Sending the identical archive again changes nothing"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419). The identical re-send is an async no-op (202, then succeeded/unchanged) rather than a synchronous 200, per FR-024/A5 (DM-01M6RA8225EXG6GAT1MM2R9T6C).

criteria.description: A stale If-Match on PUT /packs/{packId} answers 412 synchronously, and an archive holding an unknown file, a path leaving the pack, an invalid artifact, a changed pack_level or pack_id, an unstamped registered.graph.yaml, a removed field or an out-of-model preset ends refused 422 validation_failed with violations and stores nothing.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "An archive that breaks a pack rule is refused with the violations and stores nothing"; contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A stale If-Match is refused at once and no registration exists"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419). Also pinned by the outlines 'A replace may not change the level or the pack_id of the stored pack', 'A registered.graph.yaml without the registration stamp is refused...', 'A directive with a field that was removed...' and 'A preset the pack model no longer reads...'.

criteria.description: POST /packs naming a fetchable source (https_archive, git or filesystem) with its target packId and optional sha256 or commit is accepted 202, fetches the pack, applies the same validation and full replacement, and on success the status records the source location.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A pack fetched from an allowlisted https archive is registered and its source recorded"; contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A git ref is pinned to the commit it points at, and the commit is the source's record"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP17/WP18; git answers once git >= 2.50.1). Refusals pinned by the outline 'A source the service refuses ends the registration refused with pack_source_refused' (allowlist, digest mismatch, other target, foreign member).

criteria.description: DELETE /packs/{packId}/artifacts/{kind}/{artifactId} answers 204 and removes the artifact, its outgoing registered edges and the pack's preset items naming it, answers 404 with its own code when not held, and 409 artifact_referenced naming the referring pack when another pack references it.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/pack-removal.feature: "Deleting an artifact removes it and the preset item that names it, and keeps the rest of the pack"; contracts/charter/scenarios/pack-removal.feature: "An artifact another pack refers to is not deleted, and the refusal names the referrer"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP19). Outgoing edges: 'Deleting an artifact removes its outgoing registered edges...'; 404 codes: 'A path that names nothing the pack holds is a 404 with its own code'.

criteria.description: A relationship DELETE removes the edge from registered.graph.yaml only (204), answers 404 relationship_not_found when the pack holds no edge on the pair, and 409 relationship_not_registered without rewriting any file when the edge is authored in a source shard or drg/fragment.yaml, held in both, or derived.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/pack-removal.feature: "A registered relationship is removed, whichever end the request names first"; contracts/charter/scenarios/pack-removal.feature: "An edge the author wrote into a source shard is refused, and the file is not rewritten"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP19); ruling DM-01M6TQ62HXYF362GAFS2BZ3PGF and DM-01M6TR1KDAJ64GMJD6AYNZKT59. Also 'An edge the author wrote into drg/fragment.yaml...', 'A pair held both...', 'A derived relation is refused as not registered'.

criteria.description: A whole-pack replace and a DELETE are all-or-nothing: readers running alongside eight concurrent replaces only ever see one complete stored version, and an interrupted commit leaves the last committed pack served.
criteria.evidence: service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/RegistrationConcurrencyTest.java#everyReadSeesOneCompleteVersionWhileEightUploadsReplaceThePack; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/infra/storage/InterruptedCommitRepairTest.java#aReadAfterACrashServesTheLastCommittedState
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP14/WP19). Removal side: RemovalConcurrencyTest#aDeleteAndARelationshipPutOntoItNeverBothSucceed (overlap proven, squad F8).

criteria.description: An accepted ADR records that registering a whole pack replaces the known pack (removals included), per-artifact writes are helpers and removal is by DELETE, superseding ADR-0026 decision 2 and leaving ADR-0030's derived-pack removal untouched.
criteria.evidence: docs/adr/0065-pack-registration-replaces-the-whole-pack.md; docs/adr/0026-write-surface-is-functional-registration.md
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP10). ADR-0065 section 'ADR-0030: derived-pack removal is untouched'; ADR-0026 decision_status names the supersession. Verified by reading the ADRs on origin/main.

criteria.description: An activation's closure is merged in merge order (built-in, org, project) and the level that applies wins, its artifact replacing the others whole with no field inherited, so a directive held at built-in and project level is listed once with packId and level of the project version.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/layer-merge.feature: "US3 AS1 - a directive held at built-in and at project level is listed once, with the project version's provenance"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/LayerMergeTest.java#everyRuleTheMergeDecidesHasItsRow
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP21). LayerMergeTest rows C17/C18 (winner whole, languages not inherited).

criteria.description: Under a layer override, edges starting at the overridden version are dropped and edges ending at the overridden artifact resolve to the winning version.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "US5 AS2 - the edge from an overridden version is gone, the edge to it ends at the winner, and the override is listed"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/ClosureViewMergedTest.java#aReachOverTheMergedEdgesNeverFollowsAnEdgeOfAnOverriddenArtifact
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP21) merge; read surface PR C (#448, WP27/WP28).

criteria.description: A layer override that the overridden artifact's mutability level forbids (locked or extendable) refuses the compose, and the read answers 500 pack_unreadable naming the artifact, both packs and the policy, while an override of an open artifact is served.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/layer-merge.feature: "A layer override the overridden artifact's level forbids is 500 pack_unreadable, and one of an open artifact is served"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/LayerMergeTest.java#everyRuleTheMergeDecidesHasItsRow
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP21); ADR-0063 D3 (rule C21 rows in LayerMergeTest).

criteria.description: A distribution pack's descriptor overrides entry puts the named sibling's artifact in force without a pack_sibling_conflict, and the same sibling conflict without a settlement still refuses the read with 500 pack_sibling_conflict.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/layer-merge.feature: "US6 AS1 - a distribution pack's settlement puts the named member's version in force (#357)"; contracts/charter/scenarios/layer-merge.feature: "US6 AS2 - the same conflict without a settlement is refused, and an activation that avoids it still answers"
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP21); #357. Known gap recorded, not a fail: same-level settlement is not yet restricted to the distribution pack (#358, DIV-219).

criteria.description: listEffectiveArtifacts answers the artifacts in force (selected within the closure and the read-time language filter, plus the required floor, minus deny entries never on the floor), each with packId, level, state and reason, paged by keyset with a stable summary, and an artifact reached only through suggests carries its when and reason.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US3 AS2 - a denied required directive stays in force with reason required, and the deny entry is not applied"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "An artifact reached only through suggests is listed as a suggestion with its when and reason"
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP22-WP25); #408 rulings 2-3 (rulings-2026-11-07.md). Also 'The language filter applies at read only...' and 'The list is paged by a keyset cursor, and summary is identical on every page'.

criteria.description: The required floor is computed at read from the must-have items of every governing preset in the closure (convenience items excluded) and is never stored in the activation document.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US3 AS2 - a denied required directive stays in force with reason required, and the deny entry is not applied"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/RequiredFloorTest.java#aGoverningPresetsMustHaveItemIsRequiredByItsPackAndAConvenienceItemIsNot
criteria.notes: Ratchet (DIV-205), held through PR A0/B (#414, #427).

criteria.description: An enhancement is returned only when the enhancer is itself active, T is reported as enhanced by an active E, and an enhancer pulls nothing into force.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US3 AS5 - an active enhancer and its target in force are both in force, and an enhancer that is not active is absent"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "US5 AS3 - an enhancer in force is an edge of the graph, read from T's side, and one out of force is not"
criteria.notes: PR B (#427) for the list; PR C (#448) for the graph/context side. Ruling of 2026-11-06 (enhances read only when active).

criteria.description: An active E overrides T leaves T out of force with reason overridden (listed in the skipped report with its overrider), and a cycle of active overrides refuses the compose as unreadable.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US3 AS6 - an active override hides its target with reason overridden"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/InForceResolutionTest.java#anOverrideCycleAmongTheCandidatesIsRefusedAsUnreadable
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP23); DM-01M6R0TGX3DSR54EVS58Q1V8FV.

criteria.description: getActivationSkippedReport lists each artifact not in force exactly once in a typed bucket (stale id, deny not applied, language filtered, overridden, mission type not in force, enhanced target not in force, override not applied, pin not held, required not held, required not in force) and carries the activation revision.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US4 AS1 - each artifact not in force is in exactly one bucket, and the report carries the revision"; service/activations/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/activations/domain/EffectiveSetTest.java#theSummaryCountsTheWholeSetAndEveryEntryOfTheSkippedReport
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP24/WP25); language-filtered bucket per #408 ruling 2.

criteria.description: getEffectiveGraph answers only the edges among artifacts in force (an edge is dropped with either endpoint), resolved through layer overrides, with the list of layer overrides applied (artifact, winning level, losing level).
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "US5 AS1 - an edge whose endpoint is not in force is absent from the graph"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/GraphProjectionTest.java#anEdgeIsDroppedWithEitherEndpoint
criteria.notes: PR C (#448, WP27/WP28). Override listing: 'US5 AS2 - the edge from an overridden version is gone...'.

criteria.description: getEffectiveActionContext answers the in-force artifacts an action's step contract names with active enhancements, lists artifacts reached only through suggests as conditional with when and reason, answers an empty context with a skipped reason for a mission type not in force, and 404 mission_type_not_found / action_not_found otherwise.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "US5 AS4 - the context holds the artifacts in force the action reaches, with the suggestion only through suggests"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "US5 AS5 - an unknown mission type or action is 404, whether or not the mission type is in force, and a depth of 2 is 400"
criteria.notes: PR C (#448, WP28); #408 ruling 3; DM-01M7059T4K64TAVKXN3T1FKWYG. Empty context: 'US5 AS5 - the context of a mission type not in force is empty and the skipped report says why'.

criteria.description: Every effective read carries an ETag over the activation revision and the closure fingerprint, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match, and a change to a pack of the closure moves the tag.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US3 AS7 - a matching If-None-Match is 304 with the current tag"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "FR-020 - each read has an ETag of its own representation, and a matching If-None-Match is 304"
criteria.notes: PR B (#427) list/report; PR C (#448) graph/context. ADR-0059 D5 as amended (closure-scoped digest, per-representation tags).

criteria.description: All four effective reads answer 404 activation_not_found for an unknown activation and 500 pack_unreadable when the closure cannot compose.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "US4 AS2 - an unknown activation is 404 activation_not_found on both reads"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-graph-and-context.feature: "FR-021 - an unknown activation is 404 activation_not_found on the graph and on the context"; service/activations/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/activations/application/EffectiveReadServiceTest.java#anUnknownActivationOrOneWhosePackIsNoLongerConfiguredRefusesBothReads
criteria.notes: PR B (#427) and PR C (#448). 500 on list/report also pinned in layer-merge.feature (override forbidden by level).

criteria.description: EffectiveArtifactReason no longer declares kind_default and declares the new reasons (overridden, language_filtered, mission_type_not_in_force, enhanced_target_not_in_force), and the domain reason enum matches the contract enum exactly.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/schemas/EffectiveArtifactReason.yaml; service/activations/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/activations/infra/api/ActivationWireTokenParityTest.java#everyDomainTokenIsAContractValueAndNoMore

criteria.description: GET /offering and its reads are unchanged and still list every configured pack unmerged.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/offering.feature: "The packs are ordered by configured level, then by pack id in code-point order"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/OfferingReadServiceTest.java#theOrderIsByConfiguredLevelThenByIdInCodePointOrder
criteria.notes: Ratchet: offering.feature has no commit after 2026-11-05 (before this mission), and main's CI ran it green.

criteria.description: PUT /packs/{packId} and POST /packs answer 202 with a status URI after the synchronous checks, and GET on that URI answers pending, running, succeeded with the PackRegistration, or refused with the Problem, and 404 registration_not_found once forgotten.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A registration is observed pending, running and succeeded, and its status is forgotten later"; contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A revision that moves after the registration was accepted ends it refused with 412"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP16); IC-14, DM-01M6RA8225EXG6GAT1MM2R9T6C.

criteria.description: A registration, a DELETE or a per-artifact/relationship write is refused 422 naming the packs when any closure the pack joins or any stored activation's root set holding it would fail to compose, break a lock or mutability rule, or hold an enhances cycle, an enhance-and-override of one target, a self-override or an overrides edge onto a non-open target.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A registration that leaves a closure unable to compose is refused naming the packs"; contracts/charter/scenarios/pack-removal.feature: "A removal that leaves a closure of a stored activation broken is refused 422, and is accepted once the closure is whole"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/PerArtifactImpactTest.java#anOverridesEdgeOntoANonOpenTargetThroughTheRelationshipWriteIsRefusedAndAnOpenOneIsNot
criteria.notes: PR A (#419, WP15/WP19); IC-15. Per-artifact writes added by DM-01M6VG6GC40AKYYFRR35SV8HVW; strict, no repair writes (#404 out of scope, DM-01M6TQ67C9ZTNGZB9CY28JS54F). Rules outline: 'A registration whose relations break a rule is refused with that rule's code'.

criteria.description: Every (pack_version, revision) a pack ever held is remembered so a version is never reused with other content, a write drops a pin no pack holds into droppedPins instead of refusing every write, and a read reports it in pinNotHeld.
criteria.evidence: service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/PackVersionHistoryTest.java#aReusedVersionWithOtherContentIsRefusedAfterADowngradeEvenThoughItIsNotTheStoredOne; contracts/charter/scenarios/activation-ruling-changes.feature: "B1 - a per-artifact write drops a pin no pack holds into droppedPins, and a create refuses it"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "B1 - a version pin no pack holds is in pinNotHeld, and a held pin of the same document is not"
criteria.notes: PR A0/A/B (#414, #419, #427); IC-16/IC-19, DM-01M6RA9BKJY7X9BFV93QW1KM1T. History heal fixed in PR A squad F7.

criteria.description: A successful registration's status lists the must-have items and locks it added or removed and the activations whose in-force set changes, and GET /activations/{id} lists its deny entries that are not applied.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/registration/whole-pack-registration.feature: "A registration that removes a must-have item reports it in the notices"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "B4 - a registration that changes an activation's in-force set lists it in activationsAffected, and not an unrelated one"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "B4 - GET /activations/{id} lists a deny entry the floor overrides in denyNotApplied, and not an applied one"
criteria.notes: PR A (#419) floor/lock notices; PR B (#427, WP25) activationsAffected and denyNotApplied. DM-01M6RA9SAKCBSKGX165JM3CAGS. Notice kinds stay activatable-only (#417).

criteria.description: The requirement of a preset id is the union of the must-have items of every governing copy across levels (within a level the replacing copy wins), and a must-have item no pack holds is dropped from the floor and reported in requiredNotHeld.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/layer-merge.feature: "A1 - the requirement of a preset id is the union of every governing copy across levels"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "A10 - a must-have item no pack holds is in requiredNotHeld, and a held one is required and in force"
criteria.notes: PR A0 (#414) A10 and PR B (#427) A1 union; DM-01M6RA7FHRC5K8QPX7KN5FZ4S8, DM-01M6RA8MG55V8C2V9PXWDTRNQS, DM-01M6ZCXAJ9MTTF9XJSR89F3NYG. Write side: 'A1 - the union floor holds in the writes...'.

criteria.description: Overrides compose transitively (F over E over T leaves only F in force) and a requirement on T is satisfied by F, the floor being judged on the final set by iterating to a fixed point.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "A3 - in a chain F overrides E overrides T only F stays in force"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "A required T hidden by an active override is satisfied by it"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/InForceResolutionTest.java#theRequirementIsJudgedOnTheFinalSetAndTheAnswerIsExactlyTheRuledOne
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP23); DM-01M6RA7RPNZS810FTFC98Z13GH, DM-01M6RA7M56M1409EV9JX1EW83K.

criteria.description: An enhancer is in force only when its support reaches a non-enhancer in force (least fixed point), so a ring of enhancers is reported enhanced_target_not_in_force rather than holding itself up.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "A8 - an enhancer ring is not in force, and an enhancer of a target in force is"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/InForceResolutionTest.java#aRingOfEnhancersHoldsNothingUp
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP23); DM-01M6RA8G0RGRWSFW4DERH8W319, DM-01M6R4W3ZMSESETMQ0ZQTCZCFJ.

criteria.description: PUT /activations/{id} judges the floor only on the deny entries it adds and drops ids the packs no longer hold (listed in dropped), so a GET then PUT of the same body never fails without a pack change.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/activation-ruling-changes.feature: "A4 - a GET then PUT of a body whose deny entry a pack now requires is 200 with the same ETag"; contracts/charter/scenarios/activation-ruling-changes.feature: "A4 - a PUT of the body read before a pack upgrade removed an id drops the id and lists it in dropped"
criteria.notes: PR A0 (#414); IC-19, DM-01M6RA7XC5HC8915GZT2R3H83W.

criteria.description: ActivationChange.warnings names each artifact a write applied that the read will not put in force (enhanced_target_not_in_force, overridden), and an applied artifact in force warns of nothing.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "B6/B7 - a select of an enhancer whose target is denied is 200 with the warning enhanced_target_not_in_force"; contracts/charter/scenarios/effective-reads.feature: "B6/B7 - a select of an artifact an active override hides is 200 with the warning overridden"; service/activations/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/activations/application/ActivationWriteWarningsTest.java#onlyAnAppliedArtifactWarnsNotOneThatMerelyStaysOutOfForce
criteria.notes: PR B (#427, WP25); IC-17, DM-01M6RAA2B2G9PNXN2F9SJ7B1CR; warnings on additions only (DM-01M6YKZXGFGS340D1D9TE5T809).

criteria.description: A pack's policy locks and enforces only artifacts of the pack and of the packs it builds on (depends_on and lineage), never an unrelated pack's, and never binds the pack's own writes.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/scenarios/activation-ruling-changes.feature: "A15 - a project pack's kind default locks its own and its ancestors' directives, not an unrelated pack's"; contracts/charter/scenarios/activation-ruling-changes.feature: "B8 - a pack's own lock does not refuse its own per-artifact PUT, and binds the pack built on it"; service/packs/src/test/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/application/PackMutabilityPolicyClosureTest.java#a15APacksLockReachesWhatItAndThePacksItBuildsOnHoldAcrossAThreeLevelClosureAndNothingElse
criteria.notes: PR A0 (#414); IC-19, DM-01M6RA97220XBR7RR447FE2JXD, DM-01M6RAA6Y7NVVGKVKQV05GZYES.
